env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd defertry
logos run .
stdout '^ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/defertry.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/defertry.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/defertry$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/defertry$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/defertry.txt
cd ../..

cd scope
logos run .
stdout '^ok 1$'
cp stdout $WORK/scope.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/scope.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/scope$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/scope$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/scope.txt
cd ../..

cd errdefertry
logos run .
stdout '^ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/errdefertry.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/errdefertry.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/errdefertry$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/errdefertry$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/errdefertry.txt
cd ../..

module probe2

go 1.27

-- defertry/main.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import "fmt"

func g(v int) error {
	fmt.Println("g", v)
	return nil
}

func f(v int) (err error) {
	goto skip
	defer g(v)?
skip:
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := f(1); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("err:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok")
}

-- scope/go.mod --
module probe2

go 1.27

-- scope/main.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import "fmt"

func cleanup() { fmt.Println("cleanup") }

func f(v int) {
	goto skip
	scope defer cleanup()
skip:
	fmt.Println("ok", v)
}

func main() {
	f(1)
}

module probe2

go 1.27

-- errdefertry/main.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import "fmt"

func g(v int) error {
	fmt.Println("g", v)
	return nil
}

func f(v int) (err error) {
	goto skip
	errdefer g(v)?
skip:
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := f(1); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("err:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok")
}
